**Technical Automation Analyst (Finance) - India TCOE**

Artex Finance is seeking a Technical Automation Analyst within the India TCOE to support

America. This role will partner closely with Finance, Operations, IT, and Business
  
Intelligence teams to reduce manual effort, improve data quality, accelerate reporting
  
cycles, and enhance operational scalability.

* Identify, document, and automate repetitive finance and operational processes.

management processes.
  

* Build and maintain integrations between finance systems, SharePoint, Microsoft

365 applications, and reporting platforms.
  

* Monitor automation performance, troubleshoot issues, and implement continuous

improvements.
  

* Create technical documentation, process maps, and support materials for end

users.
  

* Support data governance, controls, and audit requirements related to automated

processes.
  

* Assist with month-end close, reporting, budgeting, and operational initiatives

through automation and data solutions.
  
Business Justification
  

* The role will increase automation capacity within Artex Finance, reduce manual

processing, improve reporting accuracy and timeliness, strengthen process

strategic activities. The position is expected to support multiple automation

**Qualifications:**

* University Degree and minimum 5 years of prior relevant experience, or equivalent experience.

description:
WE ARE HIRING! DATA ANALYST

**Company:** VVS Fresh N Fine  
**Department:** MIS / Business Analytics  
**Job Type:** Full-time  
**Experience:** 2+ years preferred  
**Industry:** Retail / FMCG / Supermarket / Wholesale  
**Work Location:** Cherthala, Kerala 688539 (In-person)

About VVS Fresh N Fine

At VVS Fresh N Fine, our core purpose is simple yet powerful: **To Make Life Better by Creating Value** for our customers, partner brands, team members, and communities.

We are a growing supermarket and wholesale business with multi-location operations across Kerala. We are looking for a detail-oriented and analytical **Data Analyst** to support business performance, improve operational efficiency, and enable data-driven decision-making.

Job Overview

As a Data Analyst, you will be responsible for collecting, analyzing, and interpreting business data related to sales, inventory, purchasing, finance, and operations. You will prepare reports and dashboards, identify trends and opportunities, and provide actionable insights to support management decisions and business growth.

Key Responsibilities

* Analyze sales, inventory, purchasing, and operational data to identify trends and business opportunities.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports, dashboards, and performance summaries.
* Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs), including sales, margins, stock movement, inventory turnover, and profitability.
* Develop and maintain reports using MS Excel and business intelligence tools.
* Use data visualization tools such as Power BI to present insights clearly.
* Work with relevant teams to ensure data accuracy, consistency, and timely reporting.
* Identify performance gaps, inefficiencies, and opportunities for process improvement.
* Support sales forecasting, inventory planning, budgeting, and business planning.
* Assist management in making informed, data-driven decisions.
* Maintain data confidentiality and follow company reporting standards.

Required Qualifications & Skills

* **Education:** Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Commerce, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field. A master's degree is an advantage.
* **Experience:** Relevant experience in data analysis, MIS reporting, business intelligence, or a similar role is preferred.
* **MS Excel:** Strong proficiency in advanced Excel, including PivotTables, lookup functions, formulas, and data analysis.
* **Technical Skills:** Knowledge of Power BI, SQL, and data visualization tools is an advantage.
* **Analytical Skills:** Ability to interpret data, identify trends, and generate actionable insights.
* **Business Understanding:** Knowledge of retail, FMCG, supermarket, or wholesale operations is preferred.
* **Attention to Detail:** Strong commitment to data accuracy and quality.
* **Communication:** Ability to present findings clearly and work effectively with different departments.
* **Problem-Solving:** A proactive approach to identifying issues and recommending improvements.

Our Core Values

* Innovation & Growth
* Teamwork
* Adaptability
* Dedication & Commitment
* Continuous Learning

How to Apply

If you are passionate about data, possess strong analytical skills, and want to contribute to a growing retail and wholesale business, we would love to hear from you.

Please send your updated CV/Resume to:

**Email:** vvs.vvsfreshnfine@gmail.com

**Work Location:** Cherthala, Kerala 688539

**Commute/Relocation:** Candidates must be able to commute reliably or plan to relocate before joining.

title: Principal Intelligence Analyst
company: Aged Care Quality and Safety Commission
description:
Executive Level 1
  
  
$122,620 to $139,850 + 15.4 Superannuation
  
  
All Locations
  
  
About the Aged Care Quality and Safety Commission
  
  
The Aged Care Quality and Safety Commission is the national regulator of Australian Government-funded aged care services.
  
  
We protect and enhance the safety, health, wellbeing, and quality of life of people receiving aged care. This includes managing complaints and feedback about the care older people receive.
  
  
We help build confidence and trust in aged care, by promoting best practice and a culture of safety and quality in the sector. We register providers and hold them to account if they don’t meet expected standards of care.
  
  
We work with providers, workers, older people, their families, and supporters to make sure they understand and uphold older people’s rights.
  
  
Meet some of our people and learn more about the Commission and our Regulatory Strategy on our website www.agedcarequality.gov.au
  
  
The Data, Analytics and Intelligence (DAI) Branch
  
manages and analyses data from the aged care sector and regulatory activities to understand risks and performance for the purposes of prioritising and informing preventative and responsive risk treatments and regulatory decision making.
  
  
DAI’s role is to identify risks and guide decisions that inform preventative and responsive risk treatments. DAI supports service delivery through authoritative data and intelligence practice that is contemporary and compliant with relevant legislation, regulations, standards and aligned with the strategic imperatives of the Commission.
  
  
The Intelligence and Analytics Section delivers a risk profiling, intelligence and analytics program that empowers the Commission to manage sector, provider and worker risk. The section supports decision-making across the risk management lifecycle, including:
  
  
delivering integrated risk models and AI tools that flag potential harms before they occur
  
  
providing systemic insight and guiding responses on sector-wide risks
  
  
developing intelligence on risk trends and drivers of harm for aged care workers, providers and the sector.
  
  
The section’s trusted insights are founded on advanced analytical techniques, integrated data and the multi-disciplinary skillsets of data science, analytics and intelligence.
  
  
About the Role
  
  
The Principal Intelligence Analyst is the senior intelligence specialist and operational delivery lead for the Regulatory Intelligence team. Working under the direction of the Assistant Director, the role leads execution of the Regulatory Intelligence Strategy through the coordinated delivery of timely, objective and actionable intelligence products.
  
  
The role exercises operational authority over intelligence intake, triage, sequencing and analytical delivery. It leads complex and high-priority analytical work, integrates analytical workstreams, provides authoritative quality assurance and advice, and supports the embedding of agreed intelligence governance, standards and methodologies. The role provides professional leadership, mentoring and task coordination, but does not have primary responsibility for staff performance management, workforce allocation or formal team leadership.
  
  
Position Duties
  
  
Lead execution of agreed Regulatory Intelligence Strategy priorities by converting intelligence requirements into coordinated analytical activities, products and delivery timeframes.
  
  
Lead complex Strategic Intelligence Assessments and other high-priority intelligence products, including defining analytical approaches, directing contributing workstreams and ensuring judgements are evidence-based and defensible.
  
  
Oversee the end-to-end flow of intelligence work, including intake, triage, sequencing, dependencies, milestones and the redirection of analytical effort in response to emerging intelligence and changing priorities.
  
  
Provide authoritative quality assurance and peer review to ensure intelligence products are clearly expressed, appropriately caveated and fit for executive and regulatory decision-making.
  
  
Integrate intelligence from regulatory activity, internal data, stakeholder engagement, open sources and partner agencies, and translate findings into practical implications, options and recommended actions.
  
  
Build trusted relationships and provide professional leadership, coaching and mentoring while embedding agreed governance, standards, methodologies, product frameworks and capability initiatives.
  
  
**Position Eligibility Requirements (Selection Criteria) :**  
To be successful in this role you will need to demonstrate the following:
  
  
Demonstrated experience leading complex intelligence analysis and producing high-quality strategic or operational intelligence products for executive, regulatory or risk-based decision-making.
  
  
Excellent research, conceptual thinking, analytical and problem-solving skills, including sound judgement when evaluating incomplete, ambiguous, sensitive or contested information and applying structured analytical techniques.
  
  
Strong ability to execute agreed strategic priorities through coordinated analytical delivery, including triaging requirements, directing analytical effort, integrating workstreams and managing competing demands and dependencies.
  
  
Excellent written and oral communication skills, including concise and influential briefings and rigorous quality assurance for senior and diverse audiences.
  
  
Strong stakeholder engagement and professional leadership skills, including building productive relationships, negotiating priorities, coordinating specialist effort, mentoring staff and constructively challenging assumptions.
  
  
Strong regulatory intelligence and data literacy, integrity and professional courage, including appropriate handling of sensitive information and operation within legislative, policy and information-governance requirements.
  
  
**Position Notes:**  
Salary offered will be between $122,620 - $139,850 per annum depending on skills and experience. In addition, 15.4% superannuation will be paid.
  
Only candidates who hold Australian citizenship can apply. Appointment is conditional on successfully completing a national police check. For more information, please visit www.apsc.gov.au/citizenship-aps
  
Non-ongoing opportunity will be offered for an irregular/intermittent term. Opportunities will be offered for varying periods up to 12 months with the option to extend to a total of 24 months.
  
Merit Pool established through this selection process may be used to fill this or future ongoing or non-ongoing vacancies.
  
  
In your application, please provide a statement of claims against the position eligibility requirements (selection criteria) in no more than 750 -words , including what strengths you would bring to the role, and a copy of your CV.
  
  
Please complete the application and submit by 8 November 2026, 11:59PM (AEDT).
  
Follow our guidelines for candidate use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) throughout the recruitment process.
  
  
Please contact our recruitment team on (02) 9633 3262 or recruitment@agedcarequality.gov.au for assistance with accessing our website or with lodging your application.
  
  
Specific questions about the roles can be directed to Brett Turner by emailing Brett.Turner@agedcarequality.gov.au with Position title in the subject line.
  
  
Diversity and Inclusion
  
  
The Commission is committed to fostering a workplace with flexible work arrangements to support a diverse, respectful and inclusive culture for all staff.
  
  
The Commission recognises the richness of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander cultures and is committed to the implementation of our Reconciliation Action Plan . The Commission values the unique knowledge and experience of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander employees which strengthens and supports our focus on protecting and enhancing the safety, health, wellbeing and quality of life of aged care consumers.

Under RecruitAbility you will be invited to participate in further assessment activity for the vacancy if you choose to apply under RecruitAbility; declare you have a disability; and meet the minimum requirements for the position. For more information, visit https://www.apsc.gov.au/recruitability.

* Prepare, review, and validate Business Requirements Documents (BRDs), System Requirements Specifications (SRS), user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Translate business requirements into functional specifications, process flows, use cases, and technical documentation.

* Proven experience in requirement gathering, stakeholder management, business process analysis, and solution documentation.
* Expertise in preparing BRDs, SRS documents, functional specifications, use cases, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Strong knowledge of process modelling, workflow diagrams, and UML diagrams.
* Experience managing product backlogs, prioritizing requirements, and supporting sprint planning.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to interact confidently with clients and senior stakeholders.
* Experience mentoring junior team members and reviewing business analysis deliverables.
* Ability to translate complex business requirements into clear, actionable solutions.
* Strong presentation skills and the ability to communicate business and technical concepts effectively.

Experience with relevant tools such as:

* **Project and Agile Management:** JIRA, Confluence, Trello, Asana, or Zoho Sprints.
* **Documentation and Process Modelling:** Microsoft Visio, Lucidchart, Microsoft Word, or Google Docs.
* **Wireframing and Prototyping:** Figma, Balsamiq, or Adobe XD.
* **Communication and Collaboration:** Microsoft Teams, Slack, or Zoom.

Preferred Skills

* Experience working with international clients and cross-functional teams.
* Exposure to product management, roadmap planning, and product lifecycle management.
* Experience in software development projects involving web applications, mobile applications, or enterprise systems.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced environment.

Why Join Webandcrafts?

* Work on diverse software development projects and business solutions.
* Collaborate with skilled professionals across business, design, and technology teams.
* Take ownership of complex requirements and contribute to meaningful business outcomes.
* Grow professionally in a collaborative and innovation-driven work environment.

description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------

Milestone Technologies is a global IT managed services firm that partners with organizations to scale their technology, infrastructure and services to drive specific business outcomes such as digital transformation, innovation, and operational agility. Milestone is focused on building an employee-first, performance-based culture and for over 25 years, we have a demonstrated history of supporting category-defining enterprise clients that are growing ahead of the market. The company specializes in providing solutions across Application Services and Consulting, Digital Product Engineering, Digital Workplace Services, Private Cloud Services, AI/Automation, and ServiceNow. Milestone culture is built to provide a collaborative, inclusive environment that supports employees and empowers them to reach their full potential.  
  
Our seasoned professionals deliver services based on Milestone’s best practices and service delivery framework. By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short-term and long-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.

  

**Job Overview**
----------------

Role summary

The Senior Business Systems Analyst carries the analytical execution load of the program. The role works through the detail of the existing learning estate, prepares the analysis that supports rationalisation decisions, and executes the mapping, cleanup and validation activity that follows those decisions. This is a hands-on seat and the volume of detailed work sits here.

Key responsibilities

* Build and maintain the inventory of curricula, learning items, assignments and associated attributes for assigned functional areas.
* Perform detailed analysis to surface duplicates, outdated content, incomplete records, inactive items, dummy entries and administrative accounts.
* Prepare structured analysis packs that allow stakeholders to make migrate, consolidate, archive or retire decisions efficiently.
* Execute data mapping activity between source and target structures, working to the standards agreed for the program.
* Perform and evidence data cleanup and remediation activity ahead of migration.
* Support reconciliation, test execution and user acceptance testing, and capture the associated evidence.
* Maintain trackers, logs, templates and checklists to the standard set by the Lead BSA.
* Prepare recurring status, progress and exception reporting for the assigned functional area.
* Raise data quality concerns, anomalies and emerging risks promptly through the agreed channel.

Required experience

* 8+ years of business analysis, data analysis or systems analysis experience, including involvement in a system transition or data migration.
* Strong practical data-handling capability — comfortable working at volume with spreadsheets, extracts, structured queries and reporting output.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently through detailed, high-volume analytical work with accuracy and consistency.
* Experience preparing documentation, trackers and templates to a standard suitable for a regulated environment.
* Clear written and verbal communication in English, and comfort operating with stakeholders in a different time zone.
* Willingness to work a dedicated shift pattern providing overlap with US Eastern business hours.
* Experience working within GxP-regulated environments.

Preferred experience

* Exposure to a learning management system, enterprise HR platform or comparable enterprise application.
* Experience in a regulated industry, ideally life sciences or pharmaceutical.
* Experience supporting testing and validation cycles.

Ways of working

* Works to the direction and priorities set by the assigned Client workstream lead or program owner.
* Maintains transparent, timely status against assigned activities and escalates blockers early rather than at the point of impact.
* Documents decisions, actions and open items so that context is held in the program record and not solely with the individual.
* Cross-trains across adjacent functional areas to provide coverage redundancy within the Milestone team.

Compliance and environment

* Works entirely within Client's systems, tools and environments. No client data is moved to, stored in or processed on external tooling without Client's express written approval.
* Operates within a GxP-regulated environment and follows Client's data privacy, data integrity, information security and records-retention standards at all times.
* Completes all Client-mandated onboarding, access provisioning and compliance training before commencing project activity.

Participates in Milestone's structured program induction covering program context, stakeholder map, ways of working and tooling

title: Data Analyst
description:
**Data Analyst**

We are seeking a highly skilled **Data Analyst** with **2 years of experience** in building and maintaining **ETL/ELT pipelines**, working with diverse data sources, developing **Power BI reports**, and ensuring high\-quality, reliable data across the organization.  
The ideal candidate should have strong **analytical skills**, excellent knowledge of **numbers and business context**, and hands\-on experience in **data cleaning, transformation, modeling, and optimization**.

**Key Responsibilities1\. ETL/ELT \& Data Pipelines**

* Design, develop, and maintain **ETL/ELT pipelines** for structured and unstructured data.
* Work with tools such as **Power Query, SQL\-based ETL, Dataflows, ADF, SSIS, or similar platforms**.
* Automate data ingestion, transformation, and integration workflows.
* Troubleshoot pipeline failures and optimize performance.

**2\. Data Management \& Databases**

* Work with multiple databases such as **SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Azure SQL, Oracle, or cloud\-based DBs**.
* Write optimized **SQL queries, stored procedures, views, and functions**.
* Perform data extraction, cleaning, profiling, and validation at scale.

**3\. Data Cleaning, Transformation \& Quality**

* Handle large volumes of raw data and transform them into clean, usable datasets.
* Create data validation checks and ensure **accuracy, consistency, and completeness** across systems.
* Apply data optimization techniques to improve refresh times and model performance.

**4\. Business Intelligence \& Reporting**

* Develop and maintain **Power BI dashboards, reports, and datasets**.
* Use **Power Query** and **DAX** to create calculated columns, measures, and date intelligence logic.
* Publish and manage reports in **Power BI Service**, including refresh schedules, Row\-Level Security (RLS), and workspaces.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business requirements and deliver insights.

**5\. Automation \& Productivity Tools**

* Build automation using tools like **Power Automate, Python scripts, Excel VBA, or workflow tools**.
* Implement scheduled tasks to streamline repetitive processes.
* Integrate BI outputs with email alerts, SharePoint, Teams, and other systems.

**6\. Excel \& Analytical Skills**

* Strong command of **Excel**: Power Query, PivotTables, advanced formulas, and data modeling.
* Excellent ability to work with numbers, perform analysis, detect patterns, and identify anomalies.

**7\. Domain \& Business Understanding**

* Interpret data with a strong understanding of **business KPIs, metrics, and operational logic**.
* Provide insights that support decision\-making across departments.

**Required Skills \& Experience**

* **2 years** of hands\-on experience as a Data Analyst or similar role.
* Solid experience building **ETL/ELT pipelines** and integrating diverse data sources.
* Strong SQL skills for data extraction, transformation, and performance tuning.
* Experience with **Power BI, Power BI Service**, and **Power Query**.
* Experience working with files, APIs, databases, cloud storage, SharePoint, Excel, CSV, JSON, etc.
* Strong data modeling and DAX knowledge.
* Proficiency with **Excel** (advanced).
* Experience with **automation tools** (Power Automate, scripting, or similar).
* Strong analytical thinking and numerical ability.
* Knowledge of **data validation, data governance, and data quality frameworks**.

**Good to Have (Optional)**

* Experience with **Azure Data Factory, Dataflows, Databricks, or cloud data integration tools**.
* Knowledge of Python or R for data manipulation.
* Experience working in Agile environments.
* Understanding of **version control** (Git) and CI/CD for analytics.
